module TrampolineExample where
import Control.Monad.Free (Free(..), iter)
import Data.Functor.Identity (Identity(..))

evenStep, oddStep :: Int -> Free Identity Bool
evenStep 0 = Pure True
evenStep n = Free (Identity (oddStep (n - 1)))
oddStep 0 = Pure False
oddStep n = Free (Identity (evenStep (n - 1)))

parity :: Int -> Bool
parity = iter runIdentity . evenStep

module TrampolineExample where
import Control.Monad.Free (Free(..), iter)
import Data.Functor.Identity (Identity(..))

evenStep, oddStep :: Int -> Free Identity Bool
evenStep 0 = Pure True
evenStep n = Free (Identity (oddStep (n - 1)))
oddStep 0 = Pure False

parity = iter runIdentity . evenStep

module ExecuteAroundExample where
import Control.Exception (IOException, bracket, try)
import Data.IORef (newIORef, modifyIORef', readIORef)

newtype Resource = Resource Int

run :: Int -> IO Int
run mode = do
  events <- newIORef 0
  let note n = modifyIORef' events (\x -> x * 10 + n)
      failure = ioError (userError "ResourceFailure")
      acquire = do
        note 1
        if mode == 2 then failure else pure (Resource 42)
      action (Resource value) = do
        note 2
        if mode == 1 then failure else pure value
      release _ = note 3
  result <- try (bracket acquire release action) :: IO (Either IOException Int)
  logValue <- readIORef events
  pure (either (const (-logValue)) (\value -> value * 1000 + logValue) result)

import Control.Exception (IOException, bracket, try)
import Data.IORef (newIORef, modifyIORef', readIORef)

newtype Resource = Resource Int

run :: Int -> IO Int
run mode = do
  events <- newIORef 0
  let note n = modifyIORef' events (\x -> x * 10 + n)

LMX checks at runtime and also preserves declaration-specific defaults/private/dynamic binding through its adapters. The typed foreign Callable is a comparison implementation, never an imported usage dependency.

{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds, GADTs, KindSignatures, TypeFamilies, TypeOperators #-}
module Partial (Args(..), Callable(..), Append, appendArgs, partial) where
import Data.Kind (Type)

data Args (types :: [Type]) where
  Nil :: Args '[]
  (:&) :: value -> Args rest -> Args (value ': rest)
infixr 5 :&

type family Append prefix rest where
  Append '[] rest = rest
  Append (value ': prefix) rest = value ': Append prefix rest

appendArgs :: Args prefix -> Args rest -> Args (Append prefix rest)
appendArgs Nil rest = rest
appendArgs (value :& prefix) rest = value :& appendArgs prefix rest

newtype Callable inputs result = Callable { invoke :: Args inputs -> result }

partial :: Callable (Append prefix rest) result -> Args prefix -> Callable rest result
partial (Callable operation) prefix =
  Callable (\rest -> operation (appendArgs prefix rest))
